texts.r:skill:e.e1.alpha: Mazwi anorangarirwa nyore kana uchiziva inzwi rawo rekutanga nechinzwi chekutanga. Taurai manzwi nenzwi rinonzwika pamunenge muchiverenga.
texts.r:skill:e.e1.greet: Kana wasangana nemunhu, taura kuti **Hello**. Kana uchienda, taura kuti **Goodbye**. Taura zita rako uchiti **My name is ...**.
texts.r:skill:e.e1.numcol: Dzidzai mazwi enhamba senge one, two, three... nemazwi eruvara senge red, blue, yellow...
texts.r:skill:e.e1.family: mother (amai), father (baba), grandmother (ambuya), baby (mwana mudiki kwazvo): aya mazwi evagari vemhuri yako.
texts.r:skill:e.e1.class: desk, chair, bag, pencil, book... Taurai zvinhu zviri mukirasi yenyu muchiNgezi.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.noun: Mazwi anodaidza zvinhu, senge rabbit (mhuka ine nzeve refu), bird (mhuka inobhururuka) ne fish (mhuka inoshambira), anonzi **nouns**.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.verb: Mazwi anoratidza chiito, senge jump (kusvetuka mudenga), run (kumhanya) ne eat (kuva nechikafu), anonzi **verbs**.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.like: **I like ...** zvinoreva kuti unofarira chimwe chinhu. **I have ...** zvinoreva kuti chimwe chinhu chiri chako.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.sent: Mushure me I, shandisai **am**. Mushure me You, shandisai **are**. Mutsara unoteedzana seizvi: 'ndiani → chiri chii / chinoita chii'.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.read: Kana muchiverenga, tanga matsvaga mazwi ari mumubvunzo mukati mezvinyorwa.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.build: Mutsara unoenda nenzira iyi: 'ndiani → anoita → chii'. Mushure me He, She kana zita remunhu, wedzerai **-s** kuchiito.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.tense: Pazvinhu zviri kuitika izvozvi kana kuitika kakawanda, shandisai **present**. Pazvakatoitika, shandisai **past**: wedzerai **-ed** kumagumo echiito.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.routine: get up, brush my teeth, eat breakfast, go to bed... Taurai zvamunoita zuva rimwe nerimwe muchiNgezi.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.read: Verengai zvinyorwa mutsvage kuti ndiani akaita chii, uye riini.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.abc1: Alfabheti ine **mavara makuru** ne**mavara madiki**. Mapeya mazhinji anoita akasiyana, saka dzidzai peya imwe nepeya imwe. Chenjerai zvakanyanya nemavara anoita akafanana, senge b, d, p ne q.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.snd1: Inzwi rekutanga rezwi rakabatana nechinzwi chaizvo chekutanga. Tsvagai mazwi anotanga neinzwi rimwe chete kuti muzive kuti manzwi nekupereta zvakabatana sei. Dzimwe nguva mavara maviri, senge ph, anoita inzwi re f.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.tense: Pazvino kana tsika, shandisai **present**. Pazvakapfuura, wedzerai **-ed**. Pazvichaitwa, shandisai **will + base verb**.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.qneg: Tangai mubvunzo ne**Do/Does**. Kutaura kuti kwete, shandisai **don't/doesn't**.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.adj: Mazwi senge big, small, hot ne cold anotsanangura kuti chimwe chinhu chinoita sei kana kunzwika sei.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.read: Tsvagai kuti ndiani akaita chii, uye kupi, mukunyorwa, wozopindura.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.gram: Shandisai **an** pamberi penzwi remazwi uye **a** pamberi penzwi remavara. Pachinhu chimwe, shandisai **There is**. Pazvinhu zvakawanda, shandisai **There are**.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.comp: Kuenzanisa zvinhu zviviri, shandisai **-er + than**. Che'chakanyanya', shandisai **the -est**. Pamazwi marefu, shandisai **more**.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.future: Pazvichaitwa, shandisai **will + base verb** kana **be going to + base verb**.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.transform: Pakuramba, shandisai **not / don't / doesn't / didn't**. Pambvunzo, isai **Are / Do / Does** pakutanga kwemutsara.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.read: Zvinyorwa zvakareba zviri nyore kana mukawana kuti ndiani, kupi, riini uye chii, sokunge muchizvisarudza nemutsetse.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.tense: Pazvinhu zviri kuitika izvozvi, shandisai **be + -ing**. Pazvakapfuura, shandisai **past tense**. Pazvichaitwa, shandisai **will / be going to**.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.modal: **can** (kugona), **must** (kufanira), **should** (zvakanaka kuti), **may** (zvakanaka kuti) zvinoteverwa nechimiro chechiito chepasi.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.vocab: Dzidzai mazwi ane zvinoreva zvakafanana nezvinopikisa pamwe chete, uye mazwi enyu achaita kaviri.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.read: Verengai zvinyorwa zvine mitsara yakawanda mutsvage kuti ndiani akaita chimwe chinhu, riini uye nei.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.seq1: Mazwi anoratidza kuteedzana, senge **First**, **Then / Next**, **After that** ne**Finally**, anokuudza kuteedzana kwezvakaitika.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.pun1: Mutsara unotanga ne**mavara makuru** uye unopera ne**chiratidzo chakakodzera**: ruzivo (.) pachirevo, chiratidzo chembvunzo (?) pambvunzo, uye chiratidzo chekushamisika (!) pakushamisika kana manzwiro akasimba. Mazita avanhu neizwi rekuti I anogara anonyorwa nemavara makuru.
texts.r:skill:e.vocab: Dzidzai mazwi akajairika ne**inzwi + zvinoreva + kupereta** pamwe chete uye muchazvirangarira kwenguva refu. Dzvanyai bhatani rechinyevera kuti munzwe kuti anonzwika sei.
texts.r:skill:e.be: Chiito be chinochinja chimiro nechiitiko. **I → am**, **he / she / it → is**, **you / we / they → are**.
texts.r:skill:e.pres: Kana chiitiko chiri **he / she / it (munhu wechitatu mumwe)**, wedzerai **-s / -es** kuchiito. Mazwi anopera ne-ch, -sh, -s, -x, -o anotora -es. Kune consonant + y, shandurai y kuva i muwedzere -es!
texts.r:skill:e.plural: Kune zviviri kana zvakawanda, kazhinji wedzerai **-s** kuzita. Mazita anopera ne-x anotora **-es**. Dzidzai huwandu husingatevedzi mutemo nemwoyo. Mutsara unoenda **chiitiko → chiito → zvasara**.
texts.r:skill:e.order: Kune zviviri kana zvakawanda, kazhinji wedzerai **-s** kuzita. Mazita anopera ne-x anotora **-es**. Dzidzai huwandu husingatevedzi mutemo nemwoyo. Mutsara unoenda **chiitiko → chiito → zvasara**.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.perf: have/has + past participle. Inoratidza ruzivo, kupedzwa kana kuenderera. Siyanisai since (nguva chaiyo) ne for (kureba kwenguva).
texts.r:skill:e.m2.pass: Shandisai be + past participle kutaura kuti chimwe chinhu chinoitwa kumunhu kana chinhu. Wedzerai muiti ne by.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.inf: want, hope, decide + to-infinitive; enjoy, finish, avoid + gerund. stop + to V inoratidza chinangwa, uye stop + V-ing inoreva kumisa chiito.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.comp: -er/-est ne more/most. Shandisai than nezvinoenzanisa uye the nezvepamusoro. good → better → best hazvitevedzi mutemo.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.read: Verengai mubvunzo kutanga, wozotsvaga mutsara une chiratidzo. Musoro nepfungwa huru zvinotarisa zvinyorwa zvose.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.sum1: Kupfupisa, tsvagai **pfungwa huru** muideredze kuva mitsara mumwe kana miviri. Mutsara unotaura chidimbu chimwe chete, unowedzera chinhu chisiri mukunyorwa, kana mukuru zvakanyanya hauna kunaka sekupfupisa.
texts.r:skill:e.m3.rel: Batanidzai mitsara miviri kuva mumwe ne who (vanhu), which (zvinhu), that (zvose) ne whose (kubata).
texts.r:skill:e.m3.cond: If + present, will + V (chinhu chinogoneka). If + past, would + V (kufungidzira chinhu chisiri chechokwadi zvino).
texts.r:skill:e.m3.ques: Shandisa kurongeka kwe izwi rebvunzo + chiito chemusoro + chiito. Usashandise do/does/did.
texts.r:skill:e.m3.part: -ing inoreva chiri kuitika kana chiri kuenderera; -ed inoreva chakaitwa kana chapera. Pakunzwa, shandisa -ing kune chinokonzera kunzwa uye -ed kumunhu anonzwa.
texts.r:skill:e.m3.read: Batanidza zvinoratidza kuti ugadzire mhedziso. Sarudza chinangwa chemanyorerwo nekutarisa zvikumbiro nezvirevo zvawo.
texts.r:skill:e.h1.tense: had + p.p. ndeyechinhu chakaitika pamberi pechimwe chiitiko chakapfuura. have been -ing ndeyechiito chakaenderera kusvika zvino.
texts.r:skill:e.h1.clause: where / when / why ndezvinoreva zvinoshanda semazwi ekutsanangura chiito. whether / that anotanga zvikamu zvemazita.
texts.r:skill:e.h1.partc: Bvisa chinobatanidza nemusoro wemutsara, uchichinja chiito kuita -ing. Musoro wemutsara unofanira kuva mumwe chete mumativi ose maviri.
texts.r:skill:e.h1.conn: Siyanisa chikonzero nemugumisiro (so, therefore), kupesana (however), mienzaniso (for example) nekuwedzera (in addition).
texts.r:skill:e.h1.main: Pfungwa huru inowanzova mushure me However, inotendeudza pfungwa dzakajairika, uye mumutsara wekupedzisira. Zadzisa nzvimbo isina chinhu uchitevera kuyerera kwedambudziko → mhinduro → mugumisiro.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.inv: Kana Never/Hardly/Only then ikatanga, kurongeka kunova chiito chekubatsira + musoro wemutsara. Shandisa It is ~ that pakusimbisa.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.subj: Mumitsara ye I wish / as if / If, shandisa nguva yakapfuura kumhedzisiro yezvazvino uye had p.p. kumhedzisiro yezvakapfuura.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.wh: whatever, whoever, whichever ne however + chipauro zvinoreva 'zvisinei kuti chii / ani / ipi / sei ...'.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.vocab: Fungidzira zvinoreva izwi idzva kubva kuzvinoratidza zvekupesana, muenzaniso nechikonzero, uye kubva kuchirevo chekutanga chaicho.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.logic: Tevera zvinyorwa uchishandisa zvinoreva mazwi ekuratidza nemazwi ekubatanidza. Unganidza zvidimbu kuti usvike pamhedziso.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.par: Mitsara inobatanidzwa ne and/but/or inotora chimiro chimwe chete. Chiito chinobvumirana nemusoro mukuru wemutsara.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.tone: Wana mamiriro kubva kumazwi ekutsanangura nemanzwiro. Wana chinangwa nekutarisa kuti zvinyorwa zvinobvunza, zvinozivisa kana zvinoshambadza.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.ins: Shandisa mazwi ekubatanidza, mazwi ekuratidza nekurongeka kwenguva sezvinoratidza kuti urongere mitsara uye uwane panokodzera mutsara wakapihwa.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.col: Dzidza mapoka emazwi anoenda pamwe chete, senge make a decision, take a risk ne heavy rain. Fungidzira zvinoreva tsumo kubva kumamiriro ezvinhu.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.sum: Wana pfungwa huru nemataurirwo anopesana mukunyora uye uapfupise kuita mutsara mumwe chete.
texts.r:skill:e.h.conv: Mumibvunzo yekutaura, tarisa kwete chete kuti girama yakarurama asiwo kuti mutauro unonzwika wakajairika uye une chikokiso mumamiriro iwayo. Zvekupa, kukanganisa munhu achitaura, kupindura kurumbidzwa, tsumo nekutaura zvisiri pachena zvinouya kazhinji.
texts.r:skill:e.h.job: MuChirungu chebasa, zvinhu zvikuru ndetsumo (touch base), zvidimbu zvemazwi (ASAP, nezvimwe) nemapoka echiito nechivakashure (collocations). Usashandura izwi neizwi; yeuka sezvidimbu zvinoshandiswa mumamiriro ebasa.
texts.r:skill:e.h.media: MuChirungu chenhau, kwakakosha kusiyanisa zvchaizvo nepfungwa uye kutonga kuti chikonzero chiri muchirevo chakanaka here. Yeuka mazwi akadai sekutsanangura mifananidzo (alt text, caption) nemidziyo yekugadzira maererano nechinangwa chayo.
texts.r:skill:e.h.world: Pamisoro yetsika dzepasi rose, dzidza mazwi akakosha akadai sechinhu chetsika, kusiyana-siyana uye stereotype, nemataurirwo ekuedza kunzwisisa tsika dzimwe pasina kudzitonga. Siyanisa mazwi anofanana uchishandisa zvinoratidza mamiriro.
texts.r:skill:e.h.lit: Mumibvunzo yezvinyorwa, chakakosha kuziva tsananguro yeizwi nekuriisa kuchiitiko munyaya. Chengeta foreshadowing, chiratidzo, pfungwa yekutarira, musoro wenyaya nebasa remavara akasiyana.
texts.r:skill:e.h.debate: Gakava rinoda kusiyanisa mazwi (motion, rebuttal, nezvimwe), marudzi ehumbowo nemhosva dzekufunga. Pakuongorora chirevo, tanga wabvunza kuti, "Humbowo hwechinhu ichi ndohupi?"
texts.r:skill:e.h.write: Pakunyora, sarudza chimiro chinoenderana nechinangwa nemuverengi, uye tarisa zvikamu zvemutsara (musoro nechiito) nehungwaru hwezvinobatanidza. Pamagwaro akadai seresume, zviito nenhamba zvakanaka kupfuura mazwi asina kujeka.
